article_manifest.title: Border security and energy interests.. What is behind Algeria's decision to send troops to Niger?
article_manifest.original_title: أمن الحدود ومصالح الطاقة.. ماذا وراء قرار الجزائر إرسال قوات إلى النيجر؟
article_manifest.summary: The Algerian parliament, in its two chambers, the People's National Assembly and the National Assembly, on Sunday, approved the request of President Abdelmadjid Tebboune to send units of the Algerian army to Niger, with the aim of protecting the strategic interests of the country and securing the investment projects of the state company Sonatrach, in response to a request from the Nigerian authorities.

article_manifest.title: Nigerien, 3 others nabbed over guard’s killing, theft
article_manifest.original_title: Nigerien, 3 others nabbed over guard’s killing, theft
article_manifest.summary: Operatives of the Edo State Police Command have arrested a Niger Republic national and three others over the alleged killing of a security guard and theft of goods worth over N400 million in the state. The suspects, identified as Hamisu Nuhu, Suleiman Rabiu, Hussaini Gago, a Nigerien, and Ibrahim Haruna, were arrested in connection with a robbery at Paparazzi Communication Complex in Auchi, Etsako West Local Government Area, on July 12, 2026.

article_manifest.title: 66th anniversary of the national armed forces: The garrison of Dédougou begins its preparations with a popular cross-country
article_manifest.original_title: 66e anniversaire des forces armées nationales: La garnison de Dédougou débute ses préparatifs avec un cross populaire
article_manifest.summary: The National Armed Forces launched, in Dédougou, in the Bankui region, the regional activities commemorating the 66th anniversary of their creation, on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, through a popular cross-country race followed by an aerobics session . As a prelude to the regional celebration of the 66th anniversary of the existence of the Burkinabe National Army on November 1, several preparatory activities are on display in Bankui and Sourou.

article_manifest.title: Sending a detachment of the Algerian army to Niger.. New details
article_manifest.original_title: إرسال مفرزة من الجيش الجزائري إلى النيجر.. تفاصيل جديدة
article_manifest.summary: The PNA received parliamentary and political authorization to send a detachment to Niger to protect and secure crews and energy projects for the Sonatrach International Exploration and Production Branch (Cepax).

article_manifest.title: Military cooperation: at the request of Niamey, Algeria will deploy soldiers in Niger
article_manifest.original_title: Coopération militaire : à la demande de Niamey, l’Algérie va déployer des soldats au Niger
article_manifest.summary: Convened in emergency session by decree of Algerian President Abdelmadjid Tebboune, the Council of the Nation (Senate) and the National People's Assembly, the lower chamber, both chambers of Parliament, unanimously approved the request for authorization of the deployment of Algerian military troops in Niger With this agreement of the Parliament, at the request of the Nigerien authorities according to Algiers, Algeria activates for the first time paragraph 2 of Article 91 of its 2020 Constitution and takes a major strategic step in its regional security doctrine .

article_manifest.title: Algeria: Senate approves sending troops to Niger
article_manifest.original_title: Algérie : le Sénat approuve l’envoi de troupes au Niger
article_manifest.summary: The Council of the Nation, the upper chamber of the Algerian Parliament, voted unanimously on Sunday 25 October to send a detachment of the People's National Army (ANP) to Niger, reports the Algerian daily El Khabar. The decision was adopted at a special session devoted to a request by President Abdelmadjid Tebboune According to the Algerian media TSA, the planned deployment aims to ensure the protection of the oil investments of the public company Sonatrach in northern Niger.

article_manifest.title: Algeria moves to send troops to Niger to protect energy assets in historic policy shift The upper house of parliament backs a proposed overseas deployment as Algiers deepens security ties with Niamey and seeks to safeguard strategic projects, including a planned gas pipeline linking Nigeria to European markets.
article_manifest.original_title: Algeria moves to send troops to Niger to protect energy assets in historic policy shift The upper house of parliament backs a proposed overseas deployment as Algiers deepens security ties with Niamey and seeks to safeguard strategic projects, including a planned gas pipeline linking Nigeria to European markets.
article_manifest.summary: Algeria’s upper house of parliament on Sunday approved a proposal to deploy troops to neighbouring Niger to protect energy facilities, marking a potential turning point in the country’s long-standing policy of military non-intervention beyond its borders. A senator, speaking to AFP on condition of anonymity, said 148 members of the 174-seat Council of the Nation voted in favour of the measure.

article_manifest.title: Algeria: Parliament unanimously votes on a decision to send army units to Niger The decision to send Algerian troops to Niger came four days after the signing of a memorandum of understanding to strengthen military cooperation between Algiers and Niamey.
article_manifest.original_title: Algérie: le parlement vote à l'unanimité une décision visant l'envoi des unités de l'armée au Niger La décision d’envoyer les troupes algériennes au Niger est intervenue quatre jours après la signature d'un protocole d'accord pour renforcer la coopération militaire entre Alger et Niamey.
article_manifest.summary: The Council of the Nation, the upper chamber of the Algerian parliament, unanimously adopted a decision on Sunday to send military units to Niger. Convened for an extraordinary closed session, the Algerian senators thus agree to a profound change in Algerian military doctrine that prohibited the intervention of the army outside the country's borders . The same decision will be submitted, in the afternoon, to the National People's Congress (NPC), the lower house of parliament, for a similar vote.

article_manifest.title: Algeria Senate Approves Troop Deployment to Niger
article_manifest.original_title: Algeria Senate Approves Troop Deployment to Niger
article_manifest.summary: Algeria’s upper house of parliament has approved a proposal to deploy troops to neighbouring Niger to protect energy facilities, a senator said on Sunday. The senator, who spoke to AFP on condition of anonymity, said 148 of the 174 members of the upper house voted in favour of the proposal. Algeria’s lower house is expected to vote on the measure later on Sunday.

article_manifest.title: A detachment of the Algerian army in Niger.. What is the nature of the mission?
article_manifest.original_title: مفرزة للجيش الجزائري في النيجر.. ما طبيعة المهمة؟
article_manifest.summary: Today, the National Assembly unanimously approved the request of the President of the Republic to send a detachment of the Algerian army to the State of Niger. The vote came after the President of the Republic was notified of the request to approve the dispatch of the army detachment in order to protect the investment projects of "Sonatrach" International "Cepax" at the request of the State of Niger.

article_manifest.title: Mali: the death toll from last weekend's deadly attack rises to 54 (army)
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : le bilan de l'attaque meurtrière du weekend dernier monte à 54 morts (armée)
article_manifest.summary: The Malian armed forces announced on Saturday that they had discovered 54 bodies after attacks on camps in the north-east of the country last weekend, bringing the death toll to six more. The attacks targeted the Menaka region of the troubled West African country, where gunmen reportedly arrived on motorcycles before opening fire on camps mainly housing members of the Daoussahak community It was within the Daoussahak community that the Armed Movement for the Salvation of Azawad (MSA), a group allied to the ruling junta in Mali, was born, according to security and community sources.

article_manifest.title: Algeria will deploy soldiers to Niger after a unanimous vote in the Senate
article_manifest.original_title: L'Algérie va déployer des soldats au Niger après un vote unanime du Sénat
article_manifest.summary: A unit of the People's National Army (ANP) will soon leave for Niger. Indeed, this Sunday, October 25, 2026, the upper house of the Parliament of Algeria, voted unanimously in favor of this dispatch, decided by President Abdelmadjid Tebboune. For the time being, the authorities have not communicated either the number of soldiers or the duration of the deployment But according to parliamentarians quoted by the Algerian press and taken over by the Anadolu agency, the detachment would be responsible for protecting Sonatrach oil projects in Niger.

article_manifest.title: Algerian parliament’s upper house approves troop deployment to Niger
article_manifest.original_title: Algerian parliament’s upper house approves troop deployment to Niger
article_manifest.summary: The upper house of Algeria’s parliament has unanimously approved the deployment of troops to neighbouring Niger. The Algerian constitution empowers the president to send military units abroad, provided that both chambers of parliament approve it by a two-thirds majority. article_manifest.title: Mali: the Directorate of Human Resources of the Armed Forces towards a new status
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : la Direction des ressources humaines des Armées vers un nouveau statut
article_manifest.summary: The Council of Ministers adopted a draft law amending the ordinance of 27 September 2017 establishing the Directorate of Human Resources of the Armed Forces (DRHA). The decision aims to adapt this structure to the reforms undertaken to modernize the Malian Armed Forces . Created to develop and monitor the implementation of the human resources management and development policy, the HRD faces shortcomings related to the evolution of the institutional and legal framework as well as the new requirements of the army.

article_manifest.title: Algeria's National Assembly unanimously approves sending military unit to Niger
article_manifest.original_title: الجزائر.. مجلس الأمة يصادق بالإجماع على إرسال وحدة عسكرية إلى النيجر
article_manifest.summary: Algeria.. The National Assembly unanimously approves sending a military unit to Niger October 25, 2026. Today, the National Assembly unanimously approved the decision to send an Algerian military unit to Niger, during an emergency session devoted to voting on a petition related to sending a military force beyond national borders.

article_manifest.title: Algeria's National Assembly unanimously approves sending troops to Niger
article_manifest.original_title: مجلس الأمة الجزائري يصادق بالإجماع على إرسال قوات إلى النيجر
article_manifest.summary: The Algerian National Assembly, the upper house of parliament, voted unanimously on Sunday to send units of the People's National Army to Niger, in a move that is considered a first in the Algerian army's extraterritorial tasks since the October 1973 war.

article_manifest.title: Mali military reports 54 dead after attacks in northeast
article_manifest.original_title: Mali military reports 54 dead after attacks in northeast
article_manifest.summary: Mali's armed forces say the death toll from attacks on camps in the country's northeastern Menaka region has risen to 54, after six more bodies were discovered. The attacks occurred last weekend when armed men on motorcycles reportedly opened fire on camps mainly occupied by members of the Daoussahak community. A general view of a damaged school near the Kidal regional headquarters in Kidal, Mali, May 9, 2026.

article_manifest.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
article_manifest.title: Menaka: 54 bodies found after terrorist attacks in Tagayat
article_manifest.original_title: Ménaka : 54 corps retrouvés après des attaques terroristes à Tagayat
article_manifest.summary: Bamako, 25 October (AMAP) The State – Major General of the Armed Forces informs the Opinion that on the basis of reports of a terrorist attack on civilian populations in the operational sub-sector of Menaka, a joint FAMa- Partners patrol has been launched on the ground During this search, the patrol discovered, about 35 km southeast of the city of Menaka fifty-four (54) lifeless bodies in a camp in Tagayat.

article_manifest.title: Italy: clashes between police and protesters in Rome during a march towards the Prime Minister's office
article_manifest.original_title: Italie : affrontements entre policiers et manifestants à Rome lors d’une marche vers les bureaux de la Première ministre
article_manifest.summary: The police used water cannons and batons after throwing bottles, explosive devices and fireworks by some demonstrators; 28 people were arrested as a preventive measure, according to the Italian media Clashes broke out Saturday in Rome between demonstrators and police, after an attempt to march towards the offices of Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni, while the authorities italians had stepped up security arrangements following last weekend's violence.

article_manifest.title: Two European women kidnapped in Niger freed in Libya
article_manifest.original_title: Two European women kidnapped in Niger freed in Libya
article_manifest.summary: An Austrian and a Swiss women kidnapped in Niger more than a year and a half ago have been freed and are in Libya, Bern and Vienna announced Thursday. Sixty-nine-year-old Swiss national Claudia Abbt and 76-year-old Eva Gretzmacher arrived in the eastern city of Benghazi where they received medical treatment. Their release follows an intervention by Libyan military commander Khalifa Haftar, who controls the east and parts of the south of the country.

article_manifest.title: Mali: HRW accuses army of beating civilians, JNIM refuses to punish execution of prisoners
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : HRW accuse l’armée de frapper des civils, le JNIM refuse de punir l’exécution de prisonniers
article_manifest.summary: Human Rights Watch (HRW) published an investigation into abuses since July in central and northern Mali on Monday, October 19. The NGO documents indiscriminate drone strikes by the Malian army and the execution of soldiers captured by JNIM and the Fla. HRW turns to the African Union, for lack of other interlocutor .
